item.title: AI Education in High Schools
item.description: A pilot study introducing AI concepts to high school students
item.content:encoded:
Project Overview

This pilot study aims to introduce high school students to fundamental AI concepts through engaging, hands-on activities.

Status: Pilot
Collaborators: Prof. Johnson, DeKalb High School

Objectives

  1. Demystify AI for younger learners
  2. Provide hands-on experience with AI tools
  3. Inspire interest in AI-related careers
  4. Create reusable teaching materials

Curriculum Modules

  • Module 1: What is AI?
  • Module 2: Machine Learning Basics
  • Module 3: Build Your Own AI
  • Module 4: Ethics and Society

Current Progress

We’ve completed the first four sessions with positive feedback from students.

Next Steps

  1. Complete the pilot program
  2. Gather comprehensive feedback
  3. Refine curriculum
  4. Explore partnerships with additional schools

item.title: Introduction to Neural Networks
item.description: An overview of neural network fundamentals
item.content:encoded:
Overview

This presentation introduces the fundamental concepts of neural networks, exploring how they learn from data and make predictions.

Key Topics Covered

1. Perceptrons

The building blocks of neural networks.

2. Activation Functions

  • Sigmoid
  • ReLU
  • Tanh
  • Softmax

3. Backpropagation

The algorithm that enables neural networks to learn.

Results

Our simple network achieved 95% accuracy on the MNIST test set.

References

  • Goodfellow, I., Bengio, Y., & Courville, A. (2016). Deep Learning. MIT Press.

item.title: About
item.description:
Our Mission

The NIU AI Research Group is dedicated to exploring artificial intelligence through collaborative learning, student presentations, and innovative research projects.

What We Do

  • Student Presentations: Regular presentations where students share their research and insights
  • Research Projects: Collaborative initiatives exploring AI applications and education
  • Community Building: Creating a supportive environment for AI learning
  • Educational Outreach: Extending AI education beyond the university

Get Involved

Contact us at contact@niuai.org

Location: Northern Illinois University, DeKalb, Illinois
